svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Stack de Carlos Garcia. Back: Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Keycloak, Ruby on Rails, RabbitMQ; Front: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, React Router, Next.js; Dados: PostgreSQL, Flyway, Redis; Testes: JUnit 5, Vitest, Playwright; Mobile: Flutter; Entrega: Docker, Nginx.
